name: Charan Kumar Reddy
role_line: Data, ML, AI and backend engineering
headline: I build data pipelines, ML systems and the services that run them.
intro: B.Tech student in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Data Science) and AI/ML intern at General Motors. My public work covers CDC lakehouses, feature stores, evaluated ML and RAG systems and an LLM gateway, with tests, evaluation reports and demos you can check.
about: I'm studying Electronics and Communication Engineering with a specialization in Data Science at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, and I'm currently interning at General Motors in Bengaluru.

Most of what I build sits where data meets ML: RAG systems with citations and guardrails, text classifiers measured against honest baselines, an LLM gateway, CDC pipelines into a lakehouse and a feature store guarded by data contracts. I spend most of my time on the parts that decide whether a system can be trusted: evaluation, groundedness, idempotent writes, point-in-time correctness and tests that run in CI.
When a simpler model beats a bigger one, I report it. When a number comes from synthetic data, the project says so.
open_to: I'm looking for internships and early-career roles in data engineering, ML engineering, AI engineering and backend development, especially at fintech and data-heavy companies.

focus.title: Data that arrives twice, late or broken
focus.detail: Deduplication, ordering guards and dead-letter handling in streaming pipelines, as in LakeFlow.

focus.title: Models that are evaluated honestly
focus.detail: Leak-free features, held-out test sets, and reporting the baseline when it wins, as in TicketLens.

focus.title: Services that behave under load
focus.detail: Rate limiting, caching, circuit breakers and work queues, as in NeuralGateway and txn-pipeline.

bullets: Building AI/ML and Python automation for engineering workflows in Siemens NX.
Automated die face creation for hood, fender, roof and door panels, cutting it from 18 hours to 5 minutes per panel.
Built a tool that checks and scores CAD surface quality on die faces, now used by 7 engineers on the team.
Saves the team about 47 hours of manual work a month.
Built 10+ REST APIs and Docker CI/CD, cutting integration defects by 35% and deployment time by 50%.
Automated Python classification of 50+ Jira/ServiceNow tickets a week, cutting manual effort by 40%.
Raised F1-score by 18% on 50,000+ records through PyTorch and scikit-learn tuning with 5-fold cross-validation.
Trained 5 ML models to 88% cross-validated accuracy, guarded by automated regression test suites.
Benchmarked and cut LLM inference latency by 36% (2.5 s to 1.6 s) using INT8 quantization and prompt caching.
Delivered a FastAPI log-analysis service using SSE-streaming multi-agent RAG, making diagnostics 60% faster.

Built AeroTest, a browser tool for planning and reading A/B tests: pre-experiment sample-size calculation, two-proportion z-tests, sample-ratio-mismatch checks and ROI projection, with a notebook working through the same statistics in SciPy and statsmodels.

Built ChurnIntel, a browser demo that scores customer churn risk with a logistic formula and shows each feature's contribution, answers keyword-matched questions over 100 in-memory customer records, and estimates retention-campaign ROI.
